abstract: Incremental migration from Apache Cordova, PhoneGap, or Ionic-Cordova to Capacitor: audit, Capacitor install with the same app ID, origin/scheme decisions that preserve localStorage and IndexedDB, config.xml mapping, plugin-by-plugin replacement with Capacitor and Capgo plugins, keeping Cordova plugins temporarily, Capacitor 9's optional Cordova runtime and its implications, Cordova removal, verification, and exact sync/runtime error fixes.
